summary: Intro + your voice: you film only the intro of a YouTube video (16:9); it is dressed in the style, and the rest is your cloned voice in motion design parts, with real stock shots, GIFs and your dressed cutbacks; one music, -14 LUFS, checked; a 1080p draft, the 4K on request.

prerequisites.label: Swift compiler (cutting you out of your intro, Apple Vision)
Speech-to-text (Whisper, on your Mac's GPU)
prerequisites.hint: Installed on the first video by the video engine's bootstrap (plugins/video/skills/short-editor/scripts/bootstrap.mjs): it hears your take on this Mac, free, nothing sent.

prerequisites.label: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (the AI voice: your clone or an ElevenLabs voice)
prerequisites.hint: Only for the two ways with an AI voice (Motion design + AI voice, Facecam + Motion design + AI voice): in the app, Settings › Connectors › Add key (elevenlabs.io › Developers › API keys). Your voice cloned from your take (made once, kept on your Mac) needs a plan that allows Instant Voice Cloning (Starter or above); an ElevenLabs voice works on any plan. Billed by ElevenLabs per character read (a 3:45 video: about 3,500 characters). Facecam + Motion design needs no key: your take is heard on your Mac (Whisper). With a key, Scribe can hear it instead if you ask.
prerequisites.does: Says the script with your cloned voice or an ElevenLabs voice: the two ways with an AI voice need it.
prerequisites.without: No AI voice. Facecam + Motion design needs no key: your take is heard on your Mac.
prerequisites.cost: Billed by ElevenLabs per character: a 4-minute video is about 3,500 characters. Cloning your voice needs the Starter plan or above; an ElevenLabs voice works on any plan.

prerequisites.label: GEMINI_API_KEY (the fictional people's headshots, Nano Banana 2)
prerequisites.hint: About $0.07 a headshot (1K), billed by Google. Without one, the people the video needs come from pictures you have the rights to, or are left out.
prerequisites.does: Makes the headshots of the made-up people the video shows (Nano Banana 2).
prerequisites.without: No headshot generated: pictures you have the rights to, or none.
prerequisites.cost: About $0.07 a headshot, billed by Google.

prerequisites.label: GIPHY_API_KEY (searching the GIFs)
prerequisites.hint: Free at developers.giphy.com. Without it, a GIF comes from a giphy.com link given by hand. GIPHY grants no commercial licence: organic use only.
prerequisites.does: Searches the GIFs pinned as prints in the video.
prerequisites.without: No GIF search: a GIF only from a giphy.com link you give.
prerequisites.cost: Free (developers.giphy.com). GIFs are for organic posts only.

prerequisites.label: PEXELS_API_KEY (searching Pexels' stock videos)
prerequisites.hint: Free at pexels.com/api. Without it, Mixkit's free clips are searched (no key) and a Pexels video page given by hand is fetched through its own free-download link.
prerequisites.does: Searches Pexels' stock videos for the shots between your scenes.
prerequisites.without: Mixkit's free clips only (no key needed), or a Pexels page you give.

prerequisites.label: Google Chrome (draws the films; required for the 4K)
prerequisites.hint: google.com/chrome. Without it, the 1080p draft is drawn by the headless Chrome of the motion kit; the 4K needs Google Chrome (the headless one stalls at that size).

prerequisites.label: The motion kit (fonts, Chrome, the Mac's tools)
prerequisites.hint: Set up on the first video by node plugins/video/motion/bootstrap.mjs (fonts, a headless Chrome if there is none, the Swift tools).

prerequisites.label: Music shelf (Mixkit + 4 tracks of the sound pack)
prerequisites.hint: The Mixkit track downloads from mixkit.co on the first video; the other four come with the app's sound pack (not Mixkit: fine in a video, they can block its monetisation).
